svg.title: Jerome Prakash L — Mark JPL-26 Silk Flight V10 HUD
svg.desc: A narrative JARVIS and Arc Reactor developer banner where Jerome Prakash L digitally decodes, rotates through futuristic, analysis, and armor typography modes, and synchronizes cyan, white, and gold reactor energy while silk-smooth eased motion drives a hovering reactor, aurora ribbons, floating holo-hexagons, drifting starfield, shooting stars, armor glints, and comet orbits around the Idea to Build to Launch mission.
